evidence.locator: 6507 x 6612 px; Webb NIRCam, 0.9 to 4.4 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red. The file's embedded tags give 0.02003 arcsec per pixel and north 17.2° left of vertical; the window is centred on the pixel where they place the paper's position. The same publisher's tags placed another galaxy 1.5 arcsec off (JADES-GS-z14-0), so the window's centre is the paper's position to about an arcsec; the arc passes through it.
